brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.
requirements.evidence: Cell 0,0,0 corner formed by junction 0,0|0,1|1,0. Spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at level 0 stands at that junction. Drawer drawer:0#0,1#cut at level 0 on half-n base piece:0,1,0;half-n sits on the cut face opening toward the same junction, so both occupy the same corner of piece:0,0,0;full and are adjacent with meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built triangular cluster to create shared junction: full at 0,0,0 plus half-w at 1,0,0 and half-n at 0,1,0 with upper level to lock snaps. Added spike at level 0 junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 and drawer at 0,1 level 0 on the half base cut face, placing both at the same corner of cell 0,0,0 touching with verified clear mesh.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
